content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana is a high-performance blockchain known for its low transaction fees and fast processing times. When selling digital products such as ebooks or courses, using Solana for payments means you can avoid the hefty fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale. By switching to NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, creators retain significantly more revenue. For example, if you sell 100 products at $97, the fee difference can amount to $921 retained, making this approach not only viable but also financially advantageous.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for using Solana payments involves several key components working together seamlessly. At the core, you have NOWPayments processing on-chain transactions in real-time, allowing creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. By integrating this with tools like Cloudflare Workers for automatic delivery and Google Sheets for order management, you create a robust system that operates independently of conventional payment platforms. This decentralized approach ensures you maintain control over your data and revenue, reinforcing the concept of infrastructure sovereignty.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional platforms have failed them. Whether you're in Nigeria, Venezuela, or Pakistan, you have the opportunity to sell your digital products without relying on payment systems that impose high fees or withdrawal limitations. Creators crafting ebooks, templates, or courses can provide their work to a global audience while benefitting from a low-cost payment processing system that empowers them financially.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, significantly less than traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively utilize Solana payments for your digital products, several components come into play. First, you’ll need a hosting service like Cloudflare Pages to serve your products. Next, backend logic can be managed via Cloudflare Workers, ensuring smooth order processing. Data storage can be handled through Google Sheets or Supabase for easy access and management. Finally, NOWPayments will handle the cryptocurrency transactions, facilitating automatic payment verification and order fulfillment without intermediary platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Getting started with Solana payments is straightforward. First, choose your infrastructure stack, such as the Complete Builder Kit for all necessary blueprints and templates. Next, set up your digital store using Cloudflare for hosting and order management. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, ensuring you configure your payment settings accurately. Test your setup to verify order processing and payment confirmations. Finally, launch your store and start promoting your digital products while enjoying the financial benefits of lower fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe can be achieved using cryptocurrency payment solutions like NOWPayments. By integrating a blockchain payment system, you can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring low transaction fees and immediate processing. This approach allows you to maintain full control over your sales without depending on traditional platforms.
With Solana, you can process payments instantly and cost-effectively.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell ebooks or digital downloads without the high fees of PayPal or Gumroad, consider the Complete Builder Kit for building a sovereign stack. It includes everything you need to deploy your digital store on your terms. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Using Solana for payments offers advantages like low transaction fees, fast processing times, and the ability to accept multiple cryptocurrencies, allowing digital creators to maximize their revenue.
